query:
INSERT INTO sm.etl_state (table_name, last_cursor, rows_copied, updated_at)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW())
        ON CONFLICT (table_name) DO UPDATE
            SET last_cursor = EXCLUDED.last_cursor,
                rows_copied = sm.etl_state.rows_copied + EXCLUDED.rows_copied,
                updated_at  = NOW()
